question: Which wireless transmission uses line-of-sight propagation and is used for long-distance links?
explanation: Terrestrial Microwave line-of-sight propagation use करता है और long-distance point-to-point links (जैसे telephone networks) के लिए use होता है। Relay towers हर 40-50 km पर लगाने पड़ते हैं।

question: Bluetooth technology operates in which frequency band?
explanation: Bluetooth 2.4 GHz ISM (Industrial, Scientific, Medical) band में operate करता है और FHSS (Frequency Hopping Spread Spectrum) technique use करता है।

question: Which unguided medium cannot pass through walls and requires direct line of sight even for short distances?
explanation: Infrared waves walls को penetrate नहीं कर सकती। इसीलिए TV remote, IrDA devices सिर्फ same room में काम करते हैं और direct line-of-sight चाहिए।
